what_to_do.en: Tap the list with commas in the right places.
what_to_do.ko: 쉼표가 바른 자리에 있는 목록을 누르세요.

stages.choice_rule: Write four full sentences that keep the same words in the same order. Only the commas change. The correct choice is a three-item list written as item, item, and item. Never treat a two-item list as correct. Never treat item, item and item with no comma before and as correct. Wrong choices must be unambiguously wrong: no commas, a comma after and, a comma after the verb, a comma only before and, or commas that split and from the last item. Do not add or drop nouns. Exactly one correct choice. Mix answer_index.

gold_items.stem: I like these for a snack.
choices: I like apples, bananas, and grapes.
I like apples bananas and grapes.
I like apples, bananas and, grapes.
I like, apples bananas and grapes.
We see a cat dog and bird.
We see, a cat dog and bird.
We see a cat, dog, and bird.
We see a cat, dog and, bird.
We need milk eggs and butter.
We need milk, eggs, and butter.
We need, milk eggs and butter.
We need milk, eggs and, butter.
Bring books blocks and crayons.
Bring books, blocks and, crayons.
Bring, books blocks and crayons.
Bring books, blocks, and crayons.
<NAME> packed bread, cheese, and jam.
<NAME> packed bread cheese and jam.
<NAME> packed bread cheese, and jam.
<NAME> packed bread, cheese and, jam.

gold_items.stem: They want food after the game.
choices: They want soup rice and peas.
They want soup rice, and peas.
They want soup, rice, and peas.
They want soup, rice and, peas.

gold_items.stem: She has sweet food at home.
choices: She has, cookies, cake, and fruit.
She has cookies, cake, and fruit.
She has cookies, cake, and, fruit.
She has cookies cake, and fruit.
<NAME> saw rain, wind, and snow.
<NAME> saw rain, and wind, snow.
<NAME> saw, rain, wind, and snow.
<NAME> saw rain wind, and snow.

roots: Keep the same words in the same order in all four choices. Only commas may change.
The correct form is always a three-item list written as item, item, and item.
Never mark a two-item list as correct. Never mark item, item and item with no comma before and as correct.
Tier 1 distractors drop every comma, put a comma after and, or put a comma after the verb.
Tier 2 adds a comma only before and. Tier 3 uses a near-miss extra comma after the verb while the list commas look almost right, or commas that split and from the last item.

tier_rules.1: Short stems of four to six words with picture lemmas for the list nouns. One choice is item, item, and item. Distractors drop every comma, add a comma after and, or add a comma after the verb.
tier_rules.2: Stems of five to eight words in home, school, food, or play settings. Keep the same three-item list in every choice. Add a distractor that puts a comma only before and. Use two-syllable nouns when you can.
tier_rules.3: Near-miss distractors: a comma after the verb while the list commas are otherwise right, a comma only before and, or commas that split and from the last noun. Stems may use <NAME>.

list_commas.en: Three or more items need commas. Write item, item, and item.
list_commas.ko: 항목이 세 개 이상이면 쉼표를 씁니다. 항목, 항목, and 항목처럼 씁니다.

no_comma_after_and.en: Do not put a comma after and. Write and then the last item.
no_comma_after_and.ko: and 뒤에는 쉼표를 쓰지 마세요. and 다음에 마지막 항목을 씁니다.

no_comma_after_verb.en: Do not put a comma after the action word. Start the list right away.
no_comma_after_verb.ko: 동작 말 뒤에 쉼표를 쓰지 마세요. 바로 목록을 시작하세요.

comma_before_and_only.en: Put a comma after each item before the last, not only before and.
comma_before_and_only.ko: and 앞에만 쉼표를 쓰지 말고, 마지막을 뺀 각 항목 뒤에 쉼표를 쓰세요.
